thread:
anna (Product): Hey all — we need to lock next week's cross-team roadmap sync. Two items on the table: (A) slot for RFC reviews (Billing v2 needs a sign-off) and (B) rotate agenda ownership so product/design/eng share stewardship. Proposed times: Tue 9:00am PT or Wed 2:00pm PT. Any hard conflicts?

tom (Eng): Tue 9:00am PT works for eng team. prefer earlier so async work after. :+1:

priya (Eng-Platform): Wed 2pm is slightly better for me (infra maintenance Tue morning). Can we consider Tue 9:30 instead?

jordan (Design): I prefer Tue so design folks can present mockups before dev work. If Tue, can we add a 15m deep-dive for Billing UX?

sam (SRE): Oncall rotation overlaps Tue 9:00-9:30 for me. Tue 9:30 or Wed 2pm both OK.

anna (Product): OK tradeoff: options are A) Tue 9:30-10:15 PT with 15m deep-dive for design + 30m RFC review + 15m triage, or B) Wed 2:00-2:45 PT same agenda. Quick thumbs: react with :one: for Tue 9:30, :two: for Wed 2pm. I'll tally in 2h.

tom (Eng): :one: from me

priya (Eng-Platform): :two: from me (and I can join async notes)

jordan (Design): :one: and I'll prep the deep-dive deck (5 slides).

sam (SRE): :two: but can join Tue if urgent.

anna (Product): Quick note — RFC draft link: https://docs.redwood/repo/billing-v2/rfc-draft (please comment). We need final sign-off or clear follow-ups.

tom (Eng): Will review RFC tonight. If we need a canary rollout plan, I'll sketch flags and rollout timeline.

priya (Eng-Platform): If Tue wins, I need a heads-up on infra cost estimations to bring to the RFC slot.

jordan (Design): For the deep-dive, request: show edge-case flows and error states (5m). That helps SRE/Eng.

anna (Product): Tally so far: :one: (tom, jordan) = 2, :two: (priya, sam) = 2. I'm counting myself as undecided yet. If anyone else from partner teams wants to vote, ping now.

sam (SRE): @anna I'm fine making it Tue if that ties and it's important for design timeline.

anna (Product): Alright — I'll call it Tue 9:30-10:15 PT since majority of active contributors prefer sooner and design is blocked. Jordan, you're agenda owner for this slot. Jordan to own the decision log entry for Billing RFC after the meeting.

jordan (Design): Got it — I'll own agenda this week and update the decision log. Where should I put the entry?

anna (Product): Add to the roadmap decisions doc: https://confluence.redwood/roadmap/decisions — prefix entry with "Billing v2 — 2034567890" and link RFC.

tom (Eng): Action: I'll post a short canary plan doc in the RFC thread by EOD.

priya (Eng-Platform): I'll attach infra cost slice and perf expectations to the meeting notes (drive).

calendar-bot: Tentative event created: Cross-team Roadmap Sync — Tue 9:30am PT (2034569150). Invitees: anna, tom, priya, jordan, sam. RSVP within 24h.

anna (Product): Thanks all. If anything changes, ping here. I'll update the agenda doc and add timeblocks: 9:30-9:45 — roadmap updates, 9:45-10:05 — Billing RFC review, 10:05-10:15 — triage/open actions.

jordan (Design): I'll drop the deck in the meeting thread and add slide notes.

sam (SRE): Noted. Will try to free 9:30-10:15. If oncall shifts, I'll post backup contact.

anna (Product): Closing notes: Agenda owner = jordan, RFC owner = tom (for rollout notes), infra lead = priya, decision log location confirmed. See you Tue. :calendar:
